desc: Implement prefix sum array P where P[0]=0, P[i]=sum(A_1..A_i)
Implement left-pass: for each K from 1 to N, find j* = rightmost index in [0, K-1] with A_j + P_j >= P_K using monotonic stack with C_j = A_j + P_j; set L[K] = P_{K-1} - P_{j*}
Implement right-pass: process reversed array, apply same algorithm, reverse results to get R[K]
Compute B_K = A_K + L[K] + R[K] for all K and print
Test edge cases: N=2, strictly increasing A, strictly decreasing A, all equal A
